select c_last_name, c_first_name, c_salutation, c_preferred_cust_flag, ss_ticket_number 
from (
    select ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk 
    from store_sales
    join date_dim on ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    join household_demographics on ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
    join store on ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    where d_dom between 1 and 2
      and (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' or hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      and hd_vehicle_count > 0
      and date_dim.d_year in (2000, 2001, 2002)
      and store.s_county = 'Williamson County'
) as store_sales_sub
join customer on ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
where (household_demographics.hd_dep_count / household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count > 1 or 
       household_demographics.hd_vehicle_count <= 0)
and cnt between 1 and 5
order by cnt desc, c_last_name asc
